PlayerProfile.title: PlayerProfile
PlayerProfile.description: Cloud-saved player profile, progression, unlocked arsenal, combat telemetry, custom avatar, and achievements.

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the player.

callsign.description: In-game username / operator callsign (unique across all players).

callsignLocked.description: True once unique callsign has been claimed, preventing any future changes.

avatarDataUrl.description: Custom uploaded compressed avatar DataURL or profile photo URL.

unlockedWeapons.description: Array of unlocked WeaponId strings (1 to 25 items).

bombsPlanted.description: Total C4 charges armed and planted.

unlockedAchievements.description: Array of unlocked tactical achievement IDs (up to 50 items).

economyVersion.description: Economy schema version for balance resets.

mmr.description: Skill Rating (MMR) for Ranked 5v5 matchmaking (100 to 10000).

equippedWeaponOptics.description: Map of WeaponId to equipped OpticType (up to 25 entries).

equippedWeaponSkins.description: Map of WeaponId to equipped weapon skin ID (up to 25 entries).

equippedWeaponGunsmith.description: Map of WeaponId to Gunsmith slot attachments (barrel, underbarrel, magazine, stock; up to 25 entries).

dailyContracts.description: Daily tactical contracts progress and claimed reward IDs keyed by dayKey (up to 8 entries).

diamonds.description: Real-money premium Diamonds balance credited by verified payment gateway (0 to 1000000).

vipBattlePass.description: Monthly VIP Battle Pass status, expiration timestamp, weapon of the month, XP/Cash boosts, and claimed season tiers (up to 10 entries).

unlockedOperators.description: Array of unlocked 3D Operator skin IDs (1 to 40 items).

founderDiamondsClaimed.description: True once the one-time Founder Welcome 1,500 Diamonds grant has been claimed.

unlockedWeaponSkins.description: Array of all owned weapon skin IDs (up to 60 items).

unlockedGearIds.description: Array of all owned tactical gear IDs (helmets, vests, gloves, boots, grenade packs; up to 40 items).

classLoadouts.description: Map of WarfaceClassId to ClassLoadoutConfig (primary, secondary, melee, gear; up to 6 entries).

equippedCallingCardId.description: Currently equipped static or animated calling card ID.

clanId.description: Normalized clanId of the clan this player currently belongs to, or empty string if none.

clanTokens.description: Accumulated Clan Store tokens balance (0 to 1000000).

purchasedClanOfferIds.description: Array of redeemed Clan Store offer IDs (up to 30 items).

createdAt.description: ISO timestamp when profile was first created.

updatedAt.description: ISO timestamp when profile was last synced.

UsernameRegistry.title: UsernameRegistry
UsernameRegistry.description: Ensures unique operator callsigns globally across all players.

uid.description: The UID of the player who owns this callsign.

createdAt.description: ISO timestamp when the callsign was claimed.

MultiplayerRoom.title: MultiplayerRoom
MultiplayerRoom.description: Real-time 5v5 PvP room state, round score, C4 state, and active human operator telemetry.

isPrivate.description: True if room is private (joinable only by code), false if open to matchmaking.

queueType.description: Queue mode for matchmaking: CASUAL or RANKED.

averageMmr.description: Target/average Skill Rating (MMR) of the room for Ranked matchmaking.

players.description: Map of connected human players keyed by UID (up to 12 entries).

lastHitEvent.description: Latest combat hit or elimination event broadcast in the room.

updatedAtMs.description: Epoch milliseconds of last room state update.

createdAt.description: ISO timestamp when room was created.

SocialInbox.title: SocialInbox
SocialInbox.description: Stores a player's friends list, incoming friend requests, and real-time 5v5 match invitations.

friends.description: Map of confirmed friends keyed by friend UID (up to 100 entries).

requests.description: Map of incoming friend requests keyed by sender UID (up to 50 entries).

invites.description: Map of active 5v5 room invites keyed by sender UID (up to 30 entries).

updatedAtMs.description: Epoch milliseconds of last social update.

DirectChat.title: DirectChat
DirectChat.description: Real-time direct chat thread between two friends.

chatId.description: Sorted pair of UIDs joined by underscore.

messages.description: Recent direct messages between the two operators (up to 60 items).

Clan.title: Clan
Clan.description: Tactical Clan with globally unique name/clanId, pre-configured emblem, level/XP progression, daily clan missions, and up to 7 members.

name.description: Unique display name of the clan.

motto.description: Clan tactical motto or recruitment message.

ownerUid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the clan founder/leader.

memberUids.description: Array of member UIDs (1 to 7 members maximum).

members.description: Map of ClanMemberEntry objects keyed by UID (1 to 7 entries maximum).

dailyState.description: Daily clan missions progress and claimed member UIDs keyed by mission ID.

updatedAtMs.description: Epoch milliseconds of last clan update.

createdAt.description: ISO timestamp when clan was created.

/players/{userId}.description: Stores each authenticated player's persistent profile, progression, combat stats, unlocked weapons, avatar, and achievements; supports constrained authenticated listing (rankLevel >= 1) for the Global Leaderboard.

/usernames/{usernameLower}.description: Global unique registry mapping lowercase callsign to owning player UID.

/rooms/{roomId}.description: Real-time 5v5 online multiplayer rooms for matchmaking and private code lobbies.

/social_inboxes/{userId}.description: Real-time social inbox for friends list, friend requests, and match invites.

/direct_chats/{chatId}.description: Real-time direct messages between two friends.

/clans/{clanId}.description: Tactical clans with unique normalized clanId, max 7 members, level progression, and daily missions.
